checks: Exact frozen profile hashes and bundle member pins match; bash syntax/Python AST checks independently pass.
Full immutable tree verified before GPU; role-specific private cache and immutable code mounts; network disabled.
Full expert official reference and original input immutability before profiling; captured actual expanded activation+metadata fingerprint verified around direct repeats/profile.
Temporary wrapper restored before validation/profile; source files not mutated.
Actual local/useful/padding/tail CTA counts computed from captured metadata; loaded routed JIT object hashed.
NCU selects one logical routed kernel launch, possible multiple replay executions; zeroing excluded only from selected counters, remains executed.
Refuses evidence overwrite; bounded removal and case-insensitive explicit missing-container/object proof; repeated TERM/INT ignored during cleanup.
execution_conditions: Root owns standalone300s canonical lease and obtains actual idle/exclusiveGPU; script acquires hostflock itself, do not nest lock.
Worst configured post-launch interval is240s timeout+15s forced-kill grace+25s cleanup=280s, not265s. Prelaunch verification and host overhead must fit remaining20s or root must cancel early.
Root verifies actual client/container/GPU terminal state before lease release. Unknown exit42 retains canonicallease and blocks ALL admission even though shellflock releases.
Record actual image/driver/GPU/tool provenance, ownership, exit/report artifacts and postrun hashes; unsupported metrics/error/timeout stop, no automatic retries.
interpretation_limits: Profiler timings are not clean benchmark samples or speedup/serving evidence.
Counter averages include returning/padding CTAs; distinguish actual work counts before inferring occupancy/scheduler ROI.
DRAM counters alone do not prove uncoalesced loads; barrier metrics do not uniquely attribute individual WGMMA waits.
This authorizes developmental profiling only, no promotion.
